MID-ROAR — Ancient dragon perched atop crumbling obsidian tower, jaw distended impossibly wide, throat luminous with gathering fire-orange glow about to erupt.
BREATHING FIRE — Dragon mid-flight banking hard left, cone of white-hot flame erupting from maw in turbulent arc toward wooden watchtower, embers spiraling in backdraft.
BANKING IN FLIGHT — Cobalt-scaled dragon rolling through steep spiral dive, wings tilted seventy degrees, wingtip-feathers brushing canyon wall, tail streaming behind like comet-tail.
PERCHED ON CLIFF — Dragon gripping granite promontory with obsidian talons, wings half-furled and dripping from recent emergence from storm-cloud, head turned to survey valley kingdom below.
EMERGING FROM CAVE — Dragon's horned skull and muscular forelegs emerging from vertical cave-mouth in cliff-face, eyes glowing molten-gold, illuminating limestone stalactites in mouth-entrance.
CLUTCHING PREY — Dragon on boulder field gripping mountain-goat carcass in talons, head lowered to tear flesh, wings mantled protectively over kill, blood steaming in cold air.

SLEEPING ON HOARD — Dragon coiled in cathedral-vaulted treasure chamber, body wrapped around mountain of gold coins and artifacts, thin smoke-wisp curling from nostrils, chest rising and falling slowly.
CLAWING THE SKY — Dragon reared on hindlegs atop ziggurat summit, foreclaws striking upward at descending aerial warship, wings beating to maintain balance, roar distorting air.
GLIDING LOW — Dragon wings fully extended gliding three meters above forest canopy, wingtip-vortices flattening treetops, head scanning for movement below, sunlight through wing-membranes.
TAIL LASHING — Dragon coiled on arena floor, tail whipping in blurred arc toward coliseum wall, stone exploding from impact, gladiators diving for cover.
TAKING OFF — Dragon pushing explosively from castle courtyard, hindlegs coiled then extending, wings mid-downstroke creating dust-storm, cobblestones cracking from force.
LANDING — Dragon descending into mountain village square, hindlegs extended with talons spread, wings cupped and beating backward creating windstorm, market-stalls tumbling.
INSPECTING ARTIFACT — Dragon's massive head lowered in dim ruin, single eye larger than cart-wheel examining glowing blue runestone balanced on clawtip, light casting shadows up scaled face.
CHALLENGING ROAR — Dragon atop lighthouse-tower, head thrown back, neck stretched impossibly long, mouth open releasing sound-visible as distortion-waves, beacon-fire blown horizontal.
STALKING — Dragon body low in burnt battlefield, neck extended horizontally, eyes locked on distant formation of knights, smoke still rising from dragon-scorched earth.
BARREL-ROLLING — Dragon in vertical barrel-roll through canyon, wings tucked tight, tail extended for spin-axis, canyon walls spinning in frame, aerial combat-maneuver evading ballista-bolt.
CRUSHING TOWER — Dragon gripping castle tower in foreclaws while in flight, stones breaking free and falling, dragon crushing structure inward, wings beating to maintain hover.
DRINKING FROM LAKE — Dragon crouched at mountain-lake edge, head lowered, tongue lapping water, wings folded, reflection perfect in still surface.
SHEDDING SCALES — Dragon thrashing in desert, full body convulsing, old scales lifting and breaking free in glittering cloud, new scales emerging iridescent beneath.
BREAKING ICE — Dragon crashing up through frozen lake surface from beneath, ice-sheet exploding upward in cathedral-like shards, water erupting, wings breaking free.
CLAIMING SUMMIT — Dragon alighting on mountain peak, wings spread wide against sky, talons gripping rock-spire, roar echoing across valleys, establishing territory.
FIGHTING WYRM — Dragon locked in aerial grapple with second dragon, talons interlocked, wings tangled, both plummeting toward forest, teeth snapping at each other's throats.
GUARDING EGGS — Dragon coiled around clutch of six obsidian-black eggs in cliff-ledge nest, head raised watching sky, wings partially mantled over eggs, posture defensive.
DIVING STRIKE — Dragon in vertical dive, wings swept back, talons extended forward, targeting ship's deck, sailors scattering, ocean rushing up.
MOONLIT FLIGHT — Dragon gliding over sleeping city, wings extended catching moonlight through membranes, breath misting in cold air, shadow passing over rooftops, undisturbed passage.
BANKING HARD THROUGH CANYON — obsidian-scaled dragon rolls mid-flight between twin sandstone spires, wings tilted 70 degrees, wingtip feathers grazing the cliff face and shearing off loose scree.

MID-ROAR ATOP RUINED CITADEL — jade-green dragon perched on collapsed dome of cyclopean fortress, jaw unhinged 120 degrees, throat glowing molten-orange from within, smoke curling from nostrils, neck muscles corded.

BREATHING FIRE ACROSS FROZEN LAKE — slate-blue dragon mid-stride on cracked ice, cone of white-hot flame arcing 50 meters forward, superheating air into visible shockwave, lake surface flash-melting into steam.
CLUTCHING STAG MID-FLIGHT — crimson dragon ascending through morning fog, talons buried in elk carcass, blood misting in updraft, wings beating hard against gravity, antlers tangled in dragon's grip.
EMERGING FROM OBSIDIAN CAVE — bone-white dragon pushing from volcanic tunnel, head and shoulders in dawn light, hindquarters still in shadow, eyes glowing sulfur-yellow, steam venting from nostrils.
